_comment: Voice-memo categories. Copy to ~/Library/Application Support/homeport/categories.json and edit.
With no file present, classification returns 'unknown' and summaries use a generic prompt.
strong / weak  vocabulary that identifies this category. A strong term counts fully,
a weak one counts a third. A category needs several DISTINCT matches
before it can override the window rule, so put unambiguous words in
window         optional time rule. weekdays uses 1=Sunday..7=Saturday; start/endMinute
confidential   true means the summary is written to Notes and NEVER returned to the
caller. Default is true. Only set false for things you are happy for a
sections       how the filed note is laid out: heading plus the JSON key it renders.

categories.name: meeting
categories.extractionPrompt:
Summarize this meeting. Return ONLY this JSON shape:
{"title":"<8 words max>",
 "summary":"<3 sentences>",
 "decisions":["<decision actually made>"],
 "actionItems":[{"task":"<imperative>","owner":"<name or unspecified>","due":"<yyyy-MM-dd or unspecified>"}],
 "openQuestions":["<question left unresolved>"]}
Use "unspecified" when the transcript does not say. Do not turn discussion into a decision unless it was actually settled.

categories.name: idea
categories.extractionPrompt:
Summarize this idea recording. Return ONLY this JSON shape:
{"title":"<6 words max>",
 "summary":"<2-3 sentences>",
 "points":["<the idea, stated plainly>"],
 "nextSteps":["<concrete next step, only if one was actually said>"]}
Do not invent next steps that were not mentioned.
